name: golden_compiler_power_aura
descriptor: GLB root extras.presentation_effect; matching dimensions in asset.json presentation.capsules
shape: Flat camera-facing golden shape following projected head, torso, arm, hand, leg and foot landmarks. Behind the character; no force-shield bubble or internal fire lines. Padded fully transparent border.
motion: Quiet density pulse and subtle flow; no gameplay timing or outcomes.
status: Implemented and reviewed in the shared inspector. Other runtimes call the separate effect renderer; GLB alone does not implement custom shaders.
